title: Brazilian delegation visits Sambhal farm to study intercropping
description: A delegation from major Brazilian companies visited Shri Ashutosh Pratap Singh's farm in Sambhal to inspect and praise his innovative intercropping farming model. The delegation studied how multiple crops can be grown together on the same land to maximise yield and farm income.

title: From a Rs. 25 lakh corporate job to organic farming
description: An inspiring story of Shri Ashutosh Pratap Singh, who left a lucrative Rs. 25 lakh corporate job to successfully adopt organic farming. The article highlights his transition and how he now motivates local youth and farmers to embrace natural and organic farming.

title: District Magistrate inspects vermicompost and organic farming methods
description: District Magistrate Manish Bansal and other officials inspected Shri Ashutosh Pratap Singh's farm in Gawan to examine its vermicompost and organic farming methods. He directed officials to replicate this vermicompost model across all cow shelters in the district to benefit local farmers.

title: Organic training centre teaches natural farming methods
description: The Buland Farming Group launched an organic training centre in Gawan, where Ashutosh Pratap Singh trained around 25 farmers in organic farming, multi-layer farming, and vermicompost techniques. He explained how these natural methods can generate up to Rs. 2,00,000 profit per acre.

title: Kitchen waste transformed into economic wealth through Bio-Enzyme
description: Ashutosh Pratap Singh is featured making organic Bio-Enzyme from kitchen waste and vegetable peels, turning waste into economic wealth. The article explains how this eco-friendly liquid reduces the need for chemical fertilisers and also covers his farmer training programmes on natural farming and women's empowerment.

title: How to make Bio-Enzyme from organic kitchen waste
description: An infographic explains how to make Bio-Enzyme from organic kitchen waste using a 1:3:10 ratio of sugar or jaggery, waste, and water. It highlights how the fermented liquid can serve as an eco-friendly alternative to chemical fertilisers and pesticides while managing waste and enriching soil health.

title: Bio-Enzyme applications in cow shelters
description: An article by Taru Singh details the benefits of using Bio-Enzyme in cow shelters. It explains how this natural liquid can help prevent ticks, flies, and diseases, support animal health, enhance milk production, and act as a cost-effective sanitizer for hygiene while enriching organic manure.

title: From corporate career to organic fertiliser entrepreneurship
description: An inspiring story of Shri Ashutosh Pratap Singh, who left a high-paying corporate job to start an organic fertiliser business. He trained 20 local farmers to become entrepreneurs and used social media to market his products, creating new opportunities through sustainable agriculture.

title: Organic training centre helps farmers grow four crops a year
description: The Buland Farming Group inaugurated an organic training centre in Gawan, where Shri Ashutosh Pratap Singh trained about 25 farmers in organic farming, multi-layer farming, and vermicompost. He explained how farmers can earn profits of up to Rs. 2,00,000 per acre by adopting these methods and successfully growing four crops a year.

title: Progressive farmers honoured at Krishi Goshthi in Bahjoi
description: District Magistrate Sanjeev Ranjan inaugurated a two-day Krishi Goshthi agricultural fair in Bahjoi, where progressive farmers, including Ashutosh Pratap Singh, were honoured for their contributions to agriculture. The District Magistrate encouraged farmers to use government schemes to increase their income and improve their standard of living.

title: Namami Gange workshop with Union Minister Smriti Irani
description: The National Express reported on a one-day Namami Gange workshop where Union Minister Smriti Irani was the Chief Guest. The report highlighted Ashutosh Pratap Singh's involvement in the river conservation initiative and the role of natural farming in supporting the protection of the Ganga.

title: Rajpura Sambhal FPO showcases produce at Agro Mela
description: Rajpura Sambhal FPO showcased its agricultural produce and products at the Agro Mela in Bahjoi. The display was inspected and appreciated by the District Magistrate and other officials, highlighting the value of farmer-led organisations and locally produced agricultural goods.

title: Officials inspect Rajpura Sambhal FPO initiatives
description: Officials from Amar Bhaskar inspected progressive farmer Ashutosh Pratap Singh's Rajpura Sambhal FPO. The coverage highlighted its high-quality vermicompost, bio-tonic units, and various farmer welfare initiatives supporting sustainable agriculture and rural livelihoods.

title: Farmers receive Namami Gange natural farming training
description: Under the Namami Gange Project, 70 farmers from Maulanpur and Sirsa visited Ashutosh Pratap Singh's farm in Gawan for training in natural farming and Bio-Enzyme production. The visit connected river conservation with practical agricultural methods and farmer education.

title: Joint Kisan Gosthi trains farmers in Gawan
description: A joint Kisan Gosthi was organised by the Rajpura Sambhal FPO and Krishi Vigyan Kendra in Gawan. Farmers were trained in organic farming and FPO benefits, and fruit saplings were distributed to support sustainable cultivation and diversified farm incomes.

title: Progressive farmer honoured for organic farming innovations
description: Horticulture Minister Dinesh Pratap Singh honoured progressive farmer Ashutosh Pratap Singh with a bouquet at a state-level event for his excellent organic farming work and innovations. The honour encouraged him to continue developing and sharing practical natural farming solutions.

title: Horticulture Minister recognises natural farming work
description: Horticulture Minister Dinesh Pratap Singh honoured progressive farmer Ashutosh Pratap Singh at a state-level programme for his outstanding work in organic farming and horticulture. The Minister praised his Bio-Enzyme innovations and contribution to sustainable agricultural practices.
